stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A restaurant used digital menus that changed based on ingredient availability.”?
options: A student working part-time there said the hardest part was not the technology.
On the bus home, Mr. Lee said, "Technology is useful, but old skills are still tools.
The manager said technology should serve the meal, not become the meal.
The head librarian said a library should not become only digital or only physical.
